sections.content: The W0-W6 contract requires canonical typed source selection, deterministic bounded transport, adapter-observed coverage, independent Knowledge execution/publication/review gates, immutable generations with a validated current pointer, protected attempt retention, and an end-to-end non-authorizing workflow. Ownership remains separated among VDD, maintainers, Quick Dev, and acceptance.
sections.title: Requirements and contract

sections.content: The supplied modules implement deterministic transport bound to content identity, coverage checks for missing, duplicate, unexpected, and stale pages, three-route Knowledge gate projection with publication disabled, immutable generation creation, typed current-pointer resolution, and approval-gated retention planning.
sections.title: Implementation

sections.content: The supplied tests cover stable selection identity, separate selection and content hashes, continuation identity, coverage failures and source drift, degraded and successor Knowledge routes, failed-generation pointer stability, retention approval requirements, and an end-to-end identity check. Every manifested source is represented in the snapshot.
